text:
Software Engineer II, Google Cloud
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages: Python, C, C++, Java, or JavaScript.

Responsibilities:
- Write product or system development code.
- Participate in, or lead, design reviews with peers and stakeholders.
- Review code and give feedback to ensure quality and style.
- Contribute to documentation and educational material.
- Triage product or system issues, and debug, track and resolve them.

Areas of work:
Distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, data storage, security, artificial intelligence (AI), natural language processing, UI, and mobile and full-stack development.
